name: أولوية مطلقة للتمدد على الأربعين مصدر
rewrites: buySignal := buySignal or chTriB or chSniB

stBuy = chStretch < -2.2 and chRsi3 < 20
stSell = chStretch > 2.2 and chRsi3 > 80
buySignal := stBuy or stSell ? stBuy : (buySignal or chTriB or chSniB)
sellSignal := sellSignal or chTriS or chSniS
sellSignal := stBuy or stSell ? stSell : (sellSignal or chTriS or chSniS)
